Radio

Lets the user pick exactly one option from a set. Same token language as Checkbox, but circular and mutually exclusive. The groups below are live — only one can be on at a time.

4 statesgroup · cardToken-driven

Preview

States

Selected fills the inner dot with secondary; invalid uses a danger ring; disabled drops opacity.
Unselectedborder-strong
Selectedsecondary dot
Disabledopacity .5
Invaliddanger ring

Card group

For prominent, selectable options — the whole card is the target and highlights when chosen.

Anatomy

ring → --size-box (18px) shape → --rounded-full dot fill → --color-secondary border → --color-border-strong label → --font-size-label focus → --shadow-focus-blue

Token Reference

PropertyTokenValue
Ring size--size-box18px
Shape--rounded-full9999px
Border (off)--color-border-strong#CAD5E2
Dot / ring (on)--color-secondary#2693EC
Border (invalid)--color-danger#E5242A
Card fill (on)--color-bg-card-alt#F2F9FE
Label--font-size-label / --fw-label14px / 500
Focus ring--shadow-focus-blue0 0 0 3px · 25%

Code

<label class="rdo">
  <input type="radio" name="plan" checked>
  <span class="dot"></span>
  <span class="txt"><span class="label">Starter</span></span>
</label>

<label class="rdo">
  <input type="radio" name="plan">
  <span class="dot"></span>
  <span class="txt">
    <span class="label">Pro</span>
    <span class="desc">For growing teams.</span>
  </span>
</label>

<!-- card group — whole card is the target -->
<label class="rdo rdo-card">
  <input type="radio" name="bill" checked>
  <span class="dot"></span>
  <span class="txt"><span class="label">Monthly</span><span class="desc">$29 / month, cancel anytime.</span></span>
</label>
.rdo .dot {
  width: var(--size-box); border-radius: var(--rounded-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong);
}
.rdo input:checked + .dot { border-color: var(--color-secondary); }
.rdo .dot::after {        /* inner dot — always filled, hidden via scale(0) */
  background: var(--color-secondary); transform: scale(0);
}
.rdo-card {        /* whole-card selectable variant */
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--rounded-xl); padding: 14px 16px;
}
.rdo-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong); }
.rdo-card:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--color-secondary); background: var(--color-bg-card-alt); }
.rdo input:checked + .dot::after { transform: scale(1); }        /* :checked only reveals it */

Guidelines

✓ Do
  • Use for one-of-many — exactly one selected at a time.
  • Always give the group a shared name.
  • List 2–6 options; beyond that, use a Select.
✗ Don't
  • Don't use a radio for an on/off setting — that's a toggle.
  • Don't allow multiple selections — that's a checkbox.
  • Don't hard-code the selected colour; use the token.
